question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution provides for the composition of Municipalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 243R**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 243R** of the Indian Constitution provides for the **composition of Municipalities**.
 
• This article is a part of the **74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**, which focuses on the structure and governance of **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).**
 
• Under Article 243R, municipalities are classified into three categories:
 
 
• **Nagar Panchayat:** For areas transitioning from rural to urban.
 
• **Municipal Council:** For smaller urban areas.
 
• **Municipal Corporation:** For larger urban areas.
 
 
 
• The article ensures that urban governance in India is decentralized and emphasizes the **participatory role of citizens**.
 
• It empowers the states to specify the details regarding the composition and governance of these municipalities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 243S**__

 __
 
• **Article 243S** deals with the **composition and functioning of Ward Committees** within municipalities.
 
• It mandates the creation of **Ward Committees** in municipalities with a population exceeding **3 lakh.**
 
• Ward Committees aim to ensure **local-level participation** in urban governance.
 
 
 
• **Article 243X**__
 
 
• **Article 243X** empowers the state legislatures to frame laws regarding **taxation, borrowing, and financial autonomy** of municipalities.
 
• This article emphasizes the **financial autonomy** of Urban Local Bodies to sustain their governance and developmental activities.
